AI history card: Alan Turing proposed an imitation-game framing for machine intelligence in 1950.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it asks whether a machine's conversation can be distinguished from a human's.
Geek-sized summary — Turing test: Alan Turing proposed an imitation-game framing for machine intelligence in 1950; it asks whether a machine's conversation can be distinguished from a human's.
AI history card: Frank Rosenblatt introduced the perceptron in the 1950s.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it is an early trainable model inspired by a simplified neuron.
Geek-sized summary — perceptron: Frank Rosenblatt introduced the perceptron in the 1950s; it is an early trainable model inspired by a simplified neuron.
AI history card: backpropagation efficiently computes gradients through layered models.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it became central to training modern neural networks.
Geek-sized summary — backpropagation: backpropagation efficiently computes gradients through layered models; it became central to training modern neural networks.
AI history card: CNNs use shared filters to detect local patterns.
How it works, minus the fog machine: they became foundational in computer vision.
Geek-sized summary — convolutional neural network: CNNs use shared filters to detect local patterns; they became foundational in computer vision.
AI history card: RNNs reuse hidden state across sequence steps.
How it works, minus the fog machine: they were designed for ordered data such as text and time series.
Geek-sized summary — recurrent neural network: RNNs reuse hidden state across sequence steps; they were designed for ordered data such as text and time series.
AI history card: Long short-term memory networks introduced gated memory cells.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the gates help preserve or forget information across long sequences.
Geek-sized summary — LSTM: Long short-term memory networks introduced gated memory cells; the gates help preserve or forget information across long sequences.
AI history card: attention lets a model weight some inputs more heavily than others.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it reduced the need to squeeze an entire sequence into one fixed vector.
Geek-sized summary — attention mechanism: attention lets a model weight some inputs more heavily than others; it reduced the need to squeeze an entire sequence into one fixed vector.
AI history card: the Transformer architecture was introduced in the 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it relies heavily on attention rather than recurrence.
Geek-sized summary — Transformer: the Transformer architecture was introduced in the 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need; it relies heavily on attention rather than recurrence.
AI history card: BERT popularized bidirectional pretraining for language understanding.
How it works, minus the fog machine: its masked-language objective hides tokens and asks the model to recover them.
Geek-sized summary — BERT: BERT popularized bidirectional pretraining for language understanding; its masked-language objective hides tokens and asks the model to recover them.
AI history card: GPT-style models generate text autoregressively.
How it works, minus the fog machine: they predict the next token from the tokens that came before.
Geek-sized summary — GPT: GPT-style models generate text autoregressively; they predict the next token from the tokens that came before.
AI history card: Word2vec learns vector representations of words from nearby context.
How it works, minus the fog machine: its famous analogies made embedding arithmetic widely known.
Geek-sized summary — Word2vec: Word2vec learns vector representations of words from nearby context; its famous analogies made embedding arithmetic widely known.
AI history card: GloVe learns word vectors from global word co-occurrence statistics.
How it works, minus the fog machine: its name expands to Global Vectors.
Geek-sized summary — GloVe: GloVe learns word vectors from global word co-occurrence statistics; its name expands to Global Vectors.
AI history card: an autoencoder learns to reconstruct its input through a bottleneck.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the bottleneck can force a compact representation.
Geek-sized summary — autoencoder: an autoencoder learns to reconstruct its input through a bottleneck; the bottleneck can force a compact representation.
AI history card: VAEs learn a probabilistic latent space.
How it works, minus the fog machine: they balance reconstruction with regularization toward a prior distribution.
Geek-sized summary — variational autoencoder: VAEs learn a probabilistic latent space; they balance reconstruction with regularization toward a prior distribution.
AI history card: GANs pit a generator against a discriminator.
How it works, minus the fog machine: their two-player training idea was introduced in 2014.
Geek-sized summary — generative adversarial network: GANs pit a generator against a discriminator; their two-player training idea was introduced in 2014.
AI history card: diffusion models learn to reverse a gradual noising process.
How it works, minus the fog machine: generation begins from noise and iteratively denoises it.
Geek-sized summary — diffusion model: diffusion models learn to reverse a gradual noising process; generation begins from noise and iteratively denoises it.
AI history card: reinforcement learning trains agents through rewards and penalties.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the agent must balance exploration with exploitation.
Geek-sized summary — reinforcement learning: reinforcement learning trains agents through rewards and penalties; the agent must balance exploration with exploitation.
AI history card: Q-learning estimates the long-term value of actions.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it is an off-policy reinforcement-learning algorithm.
Geek-sized summary — Q-learning: Q-learning estimates the long-term value of actions; it is an off-policy reinforcement-learning algorithm.
AI history card: MCTS grows a search tree using repeated simulations.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it played a major role in game-playing systems such as AlphaGo.
Geek-sized summary — Monte Carlo tree search: MCTS grows a search tree using repeated simulations; it played a major role in game-playing systems such as AlphaGo.
AI history card: AlphaGo defeated Lee Sedol in a five-game match in 2016.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the result became a landmark for AI in the game of Go.
Geek-sized summary — AlphaGo: AlphaGo defeated Lee Sedol in a five-game match in 2016; the result became a landmark for AI in the game of Go.
AI history card: ImageNet organised millions of labelled images across thousands of categories.
How it works, minus the fog machine: its annual challenge accelerated progress in visual recognition.
Geek-sized summary — ImageNet: ImageNet organised millions of labelled images across thousands of categories; its annual challenge accelerated progress in visual recognition.
AI history card: AlexNet won the 2012 ImageNet competition by a striking margin.
How it works, minus the fog machine: its success helped revive deep convolutional networks.
Geek-sized summary — AlexNet: AlexNet won the 2012 ImageNet competition by a striking margin; its success helped revive deep convolutional networks.
AI history card: Residual networks add shortcut connections around layers.
How it works, minus the fog machine: those shortcuts made very deep networks easier to optimize.
Geek-sized summary — ResNet: Residual networks add shortcut connections around layers; those shortcuts made very deep networks easier to optimize.
AI history card: U-Net combines a contracting path with an expanding path.
How it works, minus the fog machine: skip connections preserve spatial detail for image segmentation.
Geek-sized summary — U-Net: U-Net combines a contracting path with an expanding path; skip connections preserve spatial detail for image segmentation.
AI history card: Vision Transformers split images into patch tokens.
How it works, minus the fog machine: they adapt the Transformer idea from language to vision.
Geek-sized summary — Vision Transformer: Vision Transformers split images into patch tokens; they adapt the Transformer idea from language to vision.
AI history card: CLIP learns to align images with natural-language descriptions.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it is trained by matching correct image-text pairs against incorrect ones.
Geek-sized summary — CLIP: CLIP learns to align images with natural-language descriptions; it is trained by matching correct image-text pairs against incorrect ones.
AI history card: self-supervised learning creates supervisory signals from the data itself.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it reduces dependence on manually labelled examples.
Geek-sized summary — self-supervised learning: self-supervised learning creates supervisory signals from the data itself; it reduces dependence on manually labelled examples.
AI history card: contrastive learning pulls related representations together and pushes unrelated ones apart.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it is widely used for representation learning.
Geek-sized summary — contrastive learning: contrastive learning pulls related representations together and pushes unrelated ones apart; it is widely used for representation learning.
AI history card: transfer learning reuses knowledge from one task on another.
How it works, minus the fog machine: pretraining can save enormous amounts of labelled data.
Geek-sized summary — transfer learning: transfer learning reuses knowledge from one task on another; pretraining can save enormous amounts of labelled data.
AI history card: few-shot learning aims to adapt from only a handful of examples.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the challenge is learning without a large task-specific dataset.
Geek-sized summary — few-shot learning: few-shot learning aims to adapt from only a handful of examples; the challenge is learning without a large task-specific dataset.
AI history card: zero-shot learning predicts classes that were not directly seen during training.
How it works, minus the fog machine: semantic descriptions can bridge the gap to unseen categories.
Geek-sized summary — zero-shot learning: zero-shot learning predicts classes that were not directly seen during training; semantic descriptions can bridge the gap to unseen categories.
AI history card: federated learning trains across distributed devices without centralizing all raw data.
How it works, minus the fog machine: devices share model updates rather than their full local datasets.
Geek-sized summary — federated learning: federated learning trains across distributed devices without centralizing all raw data; devices share model updates rather than their full local datasets.
AI history card: knowledge distillation trains a smaller student model from a larger teacher.
How it works, minus the fog machine: soft teacher outputs can carry richer information than hard labels.
Geek-sized summary — knowledge distillation: knowledge distillation trains a smaller student model from a larger teacher; soft teacher outputs can carry richer information than hard labels.
AI history card: model quantization represents weights or activations with lower-precision numbers.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it can reduce memory use and speed up inference.
Geek-sized summary — quantization: model quantization represents weights or activations with lower-precision numbers; it can reduce memory use and speed up inference.
AI history card: neural-network pruning removes weights or structures judged unnecessary.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the goal is a smaller model with limited accuracy loss.
Geek-sized summary — pruning: neural-network pruning removes weights or structures judged unnecessary; the goal is a smaller model with limited accuracy loss.
AI history card: overfitting happens when a model memorizes training quirks instead of learning general patterns.
How it works, minus the fog machine: excellent training results can hide poor real-world performance.
Geek-sized summary — overfitting: overfitting happens when a model memorizes training quirks instead of learning general patterns; excellent training results can hide poor real-world performance.
AI history card: regularization discourages overly complex solutions.
How it works, minus the fog machine: techniques include weight penalties, dropout, and data augmentation.
Geek-sized summary — regularization: regularization discourages overly complex solutions; techniques include weight penalties, dropout, and data augmentation.
AI history card: dropout randomly disables units during training.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the noise discourages units from relying too heavily on one another.
Geek-sized summary — dropout: dropout randomly disables units during training; the noise discourages units from relying too heavily on one another.
AI history card: batch normalization standardizes intermediate activations during training.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it often makes optimization faster and more stable.
Geek-sized summary — batch normalization: batch normalization standardizes intermediate activations during training; it often makes optimization faster and more stable.
AI history card: gradient descent moves parameters in the direction that reduces a loss function.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the learning rate controls the size of each step.
Geek-sized summary — gradient descent: gradient descent moves parameters in the direction that reduces a loss function; the learning rate controls the size of each step.
AI history card: SGD estimates a gradient from a sample or mini-batch.
How it works, minus the fog machine: the noisy updates can make large-scale training practical.
Geek-sized summary — stochastic gradient descent: SGD estimates a gradient from a sample or mini-batch; the noisy updates can make large-scale training practical.
AI history card: Adam combines momentum-like averages of gradients and squared gradients.
How it works, minus the fog machine: its name comes from adaptive moment estimation.
Geek-sized summary — Adam optimizer: Adam combines momentum-like averages of gradients and squared gradients; its name comes from adaptive moment estimation.
AI history card: cross-validation rotates which data are used for training and evaluation.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it gives a more robust estimate than one lucky split.
Geek-sized summary — cross-validation: cross-validation rotates which data are used for training and evaluation; it gives a more robust estimate than one lucky split.
AI history card: a confusion matrix counts correct and incorrect predictions by class.
How it works, minus the fog machine: it reveals which categories a classifier confuses.
Geek-sized summary — confusion matrix: a confusion matrix counts correct and incorrect predictions by class; it reveals which categories a classifier confuses.
AI history card: precision asks how many predicted positives were right.
How it works, minus the fog machine: recall asks how many real positives were found.
Geek-sized summary — precision and recall: precision asks how many predicted positives were right; recall asks how many real positives were found.
AI history card: an ROC curve plots true-positive rate against false-positive rate.
